node.name: spawn_entity
node.args: -topic=/robot_description -entity $(var entity_name) -x $(var init_x_position) -y $(var init_y_position) -z $(var init_z_position) -R $(var init_roll_angle) -P $(var init_pitch_angle) -Y $(var init_yaw_angle)

node.name: spawn_light_source
node.args: -file $(var light_source_model_filepath) -entity $(var light_source_entity_name) -x $(var light_source_x) -y $(var light_source_y) -z $(var light_source_z) -R $(var light_source_roll) -P $(var light_source_pitch) -Y $(var light_source_yaw)

node.name: spawn_light_source_2
node.args: -file $(var light_source_2_model_filepath) -entity $(var light_source_2_entity_name) -x $(var light_source_2_x) -y $(var light_source_2_y) -z $(var light_source_2_z) -R $(var light_source_2_roll) -P $(var light_source_2_pitch) -Y $(var light_source_2_yaw)

executable.cmd: ros2 run ros_esc encoder_node /joint_states $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter $(var entity_name)/encoder_chatter --joint_names $(var joint_name_1)
ros2 run ros_esc rotate_frame_node $(var entity_name)/encoder_chatter $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter $(var rotate_frame_config_filepath)
ros2 run ros_esc sensor_pose_node /odom $(var entity_name)/encoder_chatter $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter $(var entity_name)/sensor_transform_chatter $(var sensor_transform_config_filepath)
ros2 run ros_esc cost_function_node $(var entity_name)/sensor_transform_chatter $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter $(var entity_name)/cost_value_chatter $(var cost_function_config_filepath)
ros2 run ros_esc modified_cost_node $(var entity_name)/cost_value_chatter /cost_bias /cost_modified --input_sensor_transform_topic $(var entity_name)/sensor_transform_chatter --input_odom_topic /odom
ros2 run ros_esc pde_history_node --ros-args -p omega:=$(var pde_omega)

ros2 run ros_esc convergence_detector_node --ros-args -p omega:=$(var pde_omega) -p threshold:=$(var convergence_threshold) -p decay_rate:=$(var convergence_decay_rate) -p min_fill_periods:=$(var convergence_min_fill_periods)

ros2 run ros_esc gaussian_fill_node --ros-args -p escape_policy:=$(var escape_policy) -p amplitude:=$(var gaussian_fill_amplitude) -p min_sigma:=$(var gaussian_fill_min_sigma) -p max_sigma:=$(var gaussian_fill_max_sigma) -p min_points:=$(var gaussian_fill_min_points) -p use_recent_fraction:=$(var gaussian_fill_use_recent_fraction) -p max_fills:=$(var gaussian_fill_max_fills) -p fill_cooldown_sec:=$(var gaussian_fill_cooldown_sec) -p min_distance_between_fills:=$(var gaussian_fill_min_distance_between_fills)

ros2 run ros_esc filter_node $(var entity_name)/cost_value_chatter $(var entity_name)/encoder_chatter $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter $(var entity_name)/filter_value_chatter --filter_file $(var filter_config_filepath) --append_encoder_data $(var input_encoder_data_to_filter)

ros2 run ros_esc filter_node /cost_modified $(var entity_name)/encoder_chatter $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter $(var entity_name)/filter_value_chatter --filter_file $(var filter_config_filepath) --append_encoder_data $(var input_encoder_data_to_filter)

ros2 run ros_esc controller_node $(var entity_name)/filter_value_chatter /odom $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter $(var entity_name)/control_value_chatter /cmd_vel $(var controller_config_filepath)

ros2 run ros_esc data_collection_node $(var data_collection_filepath) $(var rotate_frame_config_filepath) $(var sensor_transform_config_filepath) $(var cost_function_config_filepath) $(var filter_config_filepath) $(var controller_config_filepath) $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter /odom $(var entity_name)/sensor_transform_chatter $(var entity_name)/cost_value_chatter $(var entity_name)/filter_value_chatter $(var entity_name)/control_value_chatter $(var live_plot_mode)

ros2 run ros_esc data_collection_node $(var data_collection_filepath) $(var rotate_frame_config_filepath) $(var sensor_transform_config_filepath) $(var cost_function_config_filepath) $(var filter_config_filepath) $(var controller_config_filepath) $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter /odom $(var entity_name)/sensor_transform_chatter /cost_modified $(var entity_name)/filter_value_chatter $(var entity_name)/control_value_chatter $(var live_plot_mode)
